boundaries.programExecutionMeaning: Only audit serialization and bounded source-text/hash scans ran; original program/source/SQL did not execute.

method: AI traces code arguments/properties/SQL columns and Razor syntax. Python records the manually judged flow, exact file/range SHA/quotes, pins and bounded absence searches; it does not author or modify specification prose.

flows.observed: Search Name/Kana/PhoneNumber map to SearchCriteria.StudentName/StudentNameKana/PhoneNumber. Save input maps names, birth date, postal/prefecture/address, phone/email, emergency contact and remarks to StudentDraft; normalizer maps those to m_student columns including name_key/kana_key. Parameters carry normalized values to typed SQL fields. Reason and ReturnContextId are separate transport properties, not StudentDraft business fields.
flows.notEstablished: No app/database execution, real personal values, database encryption-at-rest or deployed field population was observed.

flows.area: search view data versus edit detail
flows.observed: Search SELECT/StudentRow includes student ID/no/name/kana/birth, affiliation/status, prefecture-name plus address1, personal phone, dates/version. WebPresentation.Row exposes ID as decimal string plus selected display fields; no address2, email, emergency contact, remarks, AdmissionDate or RowVersion in the search display object. GetAsync builds full StudentDetail/StudentDraft and StudentSaveInput.From supplies edit controls. Page model JsonElement is an internal view handoff, not a public search JSON response from these controller routes.

flows.area: browser form and generated URL channels
flows.observed: Search personal filters are rendered in a POST form to /students/search; edit/create/update values are POST controls. New/edit links contain returnContextId and optional studentId, return link contains contextId/contextRevision, and post-save 303 Location contains only escaped contextId/contextRevision. These source-generated URLs do not serialize search names/phone or student address fields. Hidden controls carry state ID/revision/tab, snapshot ID, expected version and confirmation/return tokens separately from business data.
flows.notEstablished: The claim is limited to source-generated routes/forms; it does not guarantee what an arbitrary client sends, what middleware/request logging captures, or that identifiers themselves are non-sensitive.

flows.observed: Search success copies criteria to Applied and stores SearchResult in LastResult; page/resume reuse those server-held values. Singleton ConcurrentDictionary Entry contains owner, session, tab, expiry, revision, Applied and LastResult. Token is 32 random bytes rendered as lower hexadecimal, not encoded search values. EditorSnapshotStore contains original full detail/form copies; flash stores fixed save/delete messages keyed by principal/session/context. State reads compare principal/session and optionally nonempty tab.
flows.notEstablished: Dictionary scope/lifetime is observed; durable encrypted state storage, multi-node behavior, browser private-memory guarantees, and physical memory clearing on expiry are not proven.

flows.observed: No reviewed application Response.Cookies/Set-Cookie/document.cookie write stores search criteria. Stores use memory dictionaries. Authentication AddCookie and Antiforgery configure Secure/HttpOnly/SameSiteStrict names. The evaluation SignInAsync call passes NameIdentifier, Name, Role and random login_session claims; authentication identity is separate from search student fields. Cookie ticket bytes and framework serialization were not inspected.
flows.notEstablished: Do not generalize the source comment about search personal values to no personal identifiers in every authentication cookie or operational header.

flows.observed: Outer middleware sets Cache-Control no-store, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy no-referrer and CSP default/script/style/img self, frame-ancestors none, base-uri self, form-action self before invoking the next delegate. HTTPS redirection is present. Authentication cookie expiry is 30 minutes with sliding expiration; CSRF header/cookie and automatic POST antiforgery filter are configured.
flows.notEstablished: Source configuration is not proof of deployed headers, TLS negotiation, cookie contents, browser cache behavior or production authentication setup.

flows.area: dynamic view output and Raw boundary
flows.observed: Student/control names and messages use normal Razor @ expressions and MVC asp-for/validation Tag Helpers. Search row names/address/phone use @row.GetProperty(...).GetString(), duplicate candidates use @c.StudentName, header uses @User.Identity?.Name and message panel uses @Model. Raw/Html.Raw/IHtmlContent/HtmlString/WriteLiteral patterns have zero matches in the listed reviewed application source files. RenderBody and AntiForgeryToken are view/framework markup calls, not custom Raw calls for these business strings. site.js modifies control values/attributes and removes a dialog; it does not build personal HTML via innerHTML.
flows.notEstablished: This records syntax and the absence of explicit Raw output. Framework-generated HTML, actual encoded payloads, DOM execution and an end-to-end XSS claim were not tested.

flows.observed: For non-/api failures before response start, outer middleware concatenates a static HTML shell and HtmlEncode(fault.Message or generic guidance). Unknown/system errors in Save/Delete catch return fixed messages and request IDs, not SqlException.ToString() or raw DTO payloads. WebFault field/messages are passed to ModelState, whose summary and message panel are Razor/TagHelper output.
flows.notEstablished: Model-binding-generated messages, framework/provider logging and already-started exception behavior were not executed.

flows.observed: The listed application source files contain no matching app-specific ILogger/LogCritical/Error/Warning/Information/Debug/Trace or Console call. appsettings selects Warning for Default and Microsoft.AspNetCore. The host catch consumes known/generic messages without an explicit logger call. No actual operational log file was read.
flows.notEstablished: A Warning threshold and absence of explicit application logger calls do not prove no PII in framework, hosting, SQL provider, server, proxy or operational logs.

flows.area: actual audit method arguments and saved columns
flows.observed: The actual student Audit method receives ID, CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE, before/after version, string[] changed, actor, time, reason, confirmed flag and request GUID. changed is derived by selecting dictionary keys, and JsonSerializer.Serialize(changed) stores a JSON array of column names in changed_columns. No before/after student name/address/phone values are passed to this audit INSERT. target_table=m_student, decimal target_key, actor and free reason are saved in t_operation_log; master Log uses the same column-name representation with operation_reason=NULL. AuditBuilder symbol is absent in these .cs files.
flows.notEstablished: Audit target identifiers and actor remain identifiers; absence of business field snapshots is not complete audit anonymization.

flows.observed: Save OperationReason maps to SaveRequest.Reason, Text(rawMax=60,savedMax=60,multiline=true) and NVarChar/120 @reason in t_operation_log.operation_reason. Delete reason uses required Text(60,60), is saved in both m_student.delete_reason and the DELETE audit operation_reason. Text enforces scalar length/control characters, newline conversion and trim; it does not remove names, phone numbers or addresses. User-entered reason may therefore contain personal text; no real reason content was inspected.
flows.notEstablished: Do not claim audit or delete reasons are PII-free. No new redaction feature or operational policy is requested by this source-only audit.

flows.observed: HashPayload computes SHA256 over normalized selected field key/value pairs; candidate hash uses ID/version pairs. webTokens=true in DI uses memory confirmation records containing owner/id/version/hash bytes/expiry and a random token, while the alternate non-Web branch writes hashes into t_confirmation. t_runtime_state declares encrypted_payload but no current store read/write path is connected to it. SQL client constructor requires Encrypt=Mandatory and TrustServerCertificate=false; this is connection configuration, not observed deployed transport or at-rest encryption.
flows.notEstablished: Hashing is not encryption or anonymization proof, and the unused encrypted_payload column does not prove active encryption of memory-held search/edit data.

認証の401・403、CSRFのフレームワーク拒否、画面内の検証再表示、外側例外HTMLは別経路である。AntiforgeryResultFilterのJSON変換は/apiに限られ、学生フォームに適用しない。［根拠：Infrastructure/WebHostSetup.cs:14-16、Infrastructure/AntiforgeryResultFilter.cs:7-8］

取消も局所処理で結果化されない場合、応答未開始なら一般例外経路へ到達し得る。応答開始後はこのcatchの対象外である。

manuscriptComparisons.topic: audit names versus free reason / ordinary logs

manuscriptEvidence.quote: 監査にはCREATEまたはUPDATE、対象ID、変更列JSON、変更前後版、実施者・時刻、理由、重複確認有無、受付識別情報を同じトランザクションへINSERTする。Savedは新規で取得ID・版1、更新で取得ID・読込版+1を保持する。NoChangeとConfirmationRequiredは要求対象ID・読込版を保持する。検証等のResult helperによる結果はID・版がNULLであり、異なる枝の値を一律NULLへまとめない。［根拠：Core/SqlServerStudentService.cs:226-226・262-262・287-315・385-390］
監査はDELETE、対象キー、前後版、削除・更新の変更列、実施者・時刻、理由、受付識別情報を記録する。理由の業務上限60スカラー、保存パラメータ・DB容量120は別の制約である。［根拠：Core/SqlServerStudentService.cs:385-390・396-413、database/001_schema.sql:35-37・54-54］

INSERTは正規化列に分類GENDER・PREFECTURE・ENROLLMENT_STATUS、is_deleted=0、作成・更新情報、版1を設定する。UPDATEはstudent_noを除く正規化列、更新日時・実行者、版＋1を設定し、WHEREはstudent_id=@id AND row_version=@version AND is_deleted=0。ID・版はBigInt、時刻はDateTimeOffset、実行者はNVarChar/128、項目パラメータは項目一覧の型・サイズである。SQL戻りIDがNULL・DBNullならDBConcurrencyException。監査INSERT後のcommit完了でSavedとなる。

削除はAdministrator、必須複数行理由の原入力・trim後各60スカラー、正のID・版、版上限を確認する。ReadCommitted・保存用ロック後に非削除対象の版を再読取し、不存在はNotFound、版不一致はConflict。UPDATEは同じID・比較版・非削除WHEREでis_deleted=1、deleted_at・deleted_by・delete_reason、updated_at・updated_by、版＋1を設定する。ID・版はBigInt、時刻はDateTimeOffset、実行者NVarChar/128、理由NVarChar/120。更新件数1以外はDBConcurrencyException、監査INSERT・commit後だけSavedとなる。物理DELETEではない。

根拠：`sources/Core/SqlServerStudentService.cs:92-101`、`sources/Core/SqlServerStudentService.cs:227-315`、`sources/Core/SqlServerStudentService.cs:344-383`、`sources/Core/SqlServerStudentService.cs:385-416`。

manuscriptComparisons.judgment: Basic already lists column-name JSON, actor and reason. Detail states audit INSERT without its argument/column boundary. Neither states the source-bound limitation that free reason is stored and no explicit app logger is present; neither falsely claims all logs are PII-free.

manuscriptEvidence.quote:
| t_runtime_state | DDLには状態ID、所有者、認証セッション、種別、encrypted_payload、期限、版、消費値をNOT NULLで宣言する。 | 確認した上記実装からこの表への読書きは接続されていない。列名から現行の暗号化保存・永続化・消費更新を追加しない。 |

［根拠：Infrastructure/WebHostSetup.cs:13-13、Infrastructure/SearchContextStore.cs:9-15、Infrastructure/EditorSnapshotStore.cs:7-11、Infrastructure/FlashMessageStore.cs:6-9、database/001_schema.sql:171-184］

サービスは接続文字列へEncrypt=Mandatory、TrustServerCertificate=falseを設定する。Open後に対象DBのsnapshot_isolation_state=1を確認し、不成立はInvalidOperationExceptionとする。Command helperによる検索・候補SQLのタイムアウトは30秒で、直接生成する診断コマンドはこのhelperの明示設定対象ではない。取消トークンは接続、トランザクション開始、SQL実行・読取、commitへ渡す。検索・候補読取には明示rollbackやDB例外の一般catchがなく、未commitの資源はawait usingの破棄経路へ進む。［根拠：Core/SqlServerStudentService.cs:39-73・123-170・199-216］

検索状態はSingletonのConcurrentDictionary、編集情報と通知も各メモリ辞書である。t_runtime_stateには状態識別、所有者、セッション、種別、encrypted_payload、期限、版、消費フラグのDDLがあるが、検索ストアから同表への保存・読込・暗号化・消費は接続されていない。

権限SQLはstudent_viewerへ学生・クラス・分類・コードのSELECTを付与し、staff、adminへ段階継承する。staffは学生INSERT／UPDATE・監査INSERTを許可し、学生物理DELETEを拒否する。adminはクラス・コードINSERT／UPDATEを許可する。これはDBロール定義であり、WebのRole判定や実接続利用者の権限とは別である。

根拠：`sources/Infrastructure/SearchContextStore.cs:9-15`、`sources/Infrastructure/EditorSnapshotStore.cs:7-11`、`sources/Infrastructure/FlashMessageStore.cs:6-9`、`sources/database/001_schema.sql:171-184`、`sources/database/003_web_permissions.sql:8-25`。
